== Summary ==
[[Joe Boulden]] in ''Star Trek Communicator'' 138 (2002). Head-centred crop of [[:File:Joe Boulden with Enterprise-D model, Star Trek Communicator 138.jpg]]; the caption on that photograph addresses him as Joe, in an article about him. Photo: Decipher.

== Source ==
* [[Richard Handley|Rich Handley]], "Rec Deck: Creating the Star Trek CCG", ''Star Trek Communicator'' 138 (2002), Decipher, p. 74. Scan: [https://archive.org/details/star-trek-communicator-issue-138/page/n77/mode/1up Internet Archive] (leaf n77).
* Crop: x 390–1114, y 0–912 of the 1441×912 photograph, head centred.

== Licensing ==
Non-free. Fair-use rationale: one reduced photograph from a page of a Decipher-published magazine, used only to identify Joe Boulden on his article on a non-commercial fan wiki. It cannot replace the magazine or harm its market.

== Preservation ==
archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-1/10/Joe_Boulden_Star_Trek_Communicator_138.jpg Internet Archive item].
